responsibility: Defines the MCore backend’s machine constraints used by reload, instruction selection, and machine-description matching. It assigns register constraint letters to MCore register classes and specifies the immediate, memory, and special constant ranges accepted by particular MCore instructions, including shift counts, bit-mask forms, cmov-friendly constants, inline-constant candidates, label-based memory references, and zero/one-valued operands; these predicates are consumed directly by patterns in mcore.md and helper routines in mcore.cc.
